narration_timeline.text: Can you spot this little kingfisher keeping watch beside a stretch of moving water?
narration_timeline.scene: Actual common kingfisher alongside Ljubljana waterway

narration_timeline.text: The same species appears on branches and banks, pausing between short trips.
One close recording shows a kingfisher preening its feathers while sitting on a perch.
At different waterways, these birds can stay still as the water moves past them.
narration_timeline.scene: Real kingfisher perched by a separate waterway

narration_timeline.text: Then a separate clip shows a kingfisher handling a fish it has already caught.
Watching, cleaning feathers, and eating are very different moments in a kingfisher's day.
narration_timeline.scene: Two genuine kingfisher feeding and perching clips
